findings.description: The checkout overview shows an unrounded floating-point item total for some product combinations, e.g. 'Item total: $59.980000000000004' (Bike Light $9.99 + Fleece Jacket $49.99) and '$57.980000000000004' (Fleece Jacket + Onesie). Money should be shown with two decimals.
repro: On /inventory.html choose Add to basket on Sauce Labs Bike Light and Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket
Open the cart, choose Checkout, fill First Name, Last Name, Zip and choose Continue
Look at the Item total line on /checkout-step-two.html

notes: Checked login (and its errors), inventory, sort orders, detail pages, add/remove, cart, checkout totals for all 15 two-item pairs, logout and redirects, mobile width. Everything else behaved correctly. The app says 'basket' where the brief says 'cart', consistently on every page, so I treated it as deliberate wording and did not report it.

cost.notes: estimate from 97503 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0195-$0.2340
